title: Points of interest
description: How points of interest are placed in the neutral zone (CB-8c, CB-8d) guarded (CB-8e) and captured (CB-8f): the chance that a plot band gets one, the margin from the band edges, the buffs a point can have, the neutral guards each point starts with and the capture numbers. The tries per point are mapgen.json placementTries. The numbers of each buff kind are not here yet (CB-8g).

chancePercent.description: Chance in percent that a plot band gets a point.

bandMarginCells.description: Cells kept free at each edge of a band. Twice it must be below plotWidth.

buffs.description: The buffs a point can have; one weighted pick in file order.

capture.description: How units divert to a point and capture it (CB-8f). A unit of a side that does not hold a point diverts to it when within pointAggroRangeCells of it with a clear line of sight, and waits within captureRadiusCells. Each tick with no guard alive and units of one side only in captureRadiusCells, progress grows by the number of those units (at most maxCapturersCounted); at captureTicks the side takes the point.

captureTicks.description: Progress that takes a point (50 ticks: 5 seconds for one unit).

maxCapturersCounted.description: Most units counted per tick in the capture range.

captureRadiusCells.description: A diverted unit this close to the point's centre waits; units this close count as capturing.

pointAggroRangeCells.description: A unit this close to the point's centre, with a clear line of sight, diverts to it.

guards.description: The neutral guards of every point (CB-8e). The budget of a point is baseBudget grown by growthPercent per round after round 1 (like the threat budget, SC-1); it buys units from the weighted list, at most maxGuardsPerPoint of them; what is left over becomes a strength percent of the point's guards.

baseBudget.description: Budget of one point in round 1.

growthPercent.description: Percent of the budget kept each round (125 grows it by 25%).

leashCells.description: A guard farther than this many cells from its point drops its target and walks back.

units.description: The guard units, in file order (the order of the weighted draw). Ground units only.
